PreToolUse.matcher: tool == "Bash" && tool_input.command matches "(expo start|npx expo start|bun expo start|bunx expo start|yarn expo start)"

hooks.command:
#!/bin/bash
input=$(cat)
echo '[Hook] BLOCKED: Expo dev server must run in tmux for log access' >&2
echo '[Hook] Use this command instead:' >&2
echo "[Hook] tmux new-session -d -s dev 'bun expo start'" >&2
echo '[Hook] Then: tmux attach -t dev' >&2
exit 1

#!/bin/bash
input=$(cat)
file_path=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // ""')
if [[ "$file_path" =~ \.(md|txt)$ ]] && [[ ! "$file_path" =~ (README|CLAUDE|AGENTS|CONTRIBUTING)\.md$ ]]; then
  echo "[Hook] BLOCKED: Unnecessary documentation file creation" >&2
  echo "[Hook] File: $file_path" >&2
  exit 1
fi
echo "$input"

#!/bin/bash
# console.log check
input=$(cat)
file_path=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // ""')
if [ -n "$file_path" ] && [ -f "$file_path" ]; then
  console_logs=$(grep -n "console\.log" "$file_path" 2>/dev/null || true)
  if [ -n "$console_logs" ]; then
    echo "[Hook] WARNING: console.log found in $file_path" >&2
    echo "$console_logs" | head -5 >&2
    echo "[Hook] Remove console.log before committing" >&2
  fi
fi
echo "$input"

#!/bin/bash
# Relative import check — ~ alias required
input=$(cat)
file_path=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // ""')
if [ -n "$file_path" ] && [ -f "$file_path" ]; then
  relative_imports=$(grep -n "from '\.\.\?/" "$file_path" 2>/dev/null || true)
  if [ -n "$relative_imports" ]; then
    echo "[Hook] WARNING: Relative import detected in $file_path" >&2
    echo "$relative_imports" | head -5 >&2
    echo "[Hook] Use '~/' alias instead of relative paths" >&2
  fi
fi
echo "$input"

#!/bin/bash
# interface keyword check — use type instead
input=$(cat)
file_path=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // ""')
if [ -n "$file_path" ] && [ -f "$file_path" ]; then
  interfaces=$(grep -n "^\s*\(export \)\?interface " "$file_path" 2>/dev/null || true)
  if [ -n "$interfaces" ]; then
    echo "[Hook] WARNING: 'interface' found in $file_path — use 'type' instead" >&2
    echo "$interfaces" | head -5 >&2
  fi
fi
echo "$input"

#!/bin/bash
# export default check — forbidden outside app/ directory
input=$(cat)
file_path=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // ""')
if [ -n "$file_path" ] && [ -f "$file_path" ]; then
  if [[ ! "$file_path" =~ /app/ ]]; then
    defaults=$(grep -n "export default" "$file_path" 2>/dev/null || true)
    if [ -n "$defaults" ]; then
      echo "[Hook] WARNING: 'export default' found in $file_path" >&2
      echo "$defaults" | head -5 >&2
      echo "[Hook] Use named exports. Default exports are only allowed in app/ screens." >&2
    fi
  fi
fi
echo "$input"

#!/bin/bash
# try-catch check — use better-result pattern instead
input=$(cat)
file_path=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // ""')
if [ -n "$file_path" ] && [ -f "$file_path" ]; then
  # Exclude test files
  if [[ ! "$file_path" =~ \.(test|spec)\.(ts|tsx)$ ]]; then
    trycatch=$(grep -n "} catch\|try {" "$file_path" 2>/dev/null || true)
    if [ -n "$trycatch" ]; then
      echo "[Hook] WARNING: try-catch found in $file_path" >&2
      echo "$trycatch" | head -5 >&2
      echo "[Hook] Use better-result pattern (Result.tryPromise / result.match) instead" >&2
    fi
  fi
fi
echo "$input"

#!/bin/bash
# testID check — forbidden, use accessibility roles instead
input=$(cat)
file_path=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // ""')
if [ -n "$file_path" ] && [ -f "$file_path" ]; then
  testids=$(grep -n "testID=" "$file_path" 2>/dev/null || true)
  if [ -n "$testids" ]; then
    echo "[Hook] WARNING: testID found in $file_path" >&2
    echo "$testids" | head -5 >&2
    echo "[Hook] Use accessibilityRole + accessibilityLabel instead of testID" >&2
  fi
fi
echo "$input"

#!/bin/bash
# Final console.log audit across all modified files
input=$(cat)
if git rev-parse --git-dir > /dev/null 2>&1; then
  modified_files=$(git diff --name-only HEAD 2>/dev/null | grep -E '\.(ts|tsx|js|jsx)$' || true)
  if [ -n "$modified_files" ]; then
    has_console=false
    while IFS= read -r file; do
      if [ -f "$file" ] && grep -q "console\.log" "$file" 2>/dev/null; then
        echo "[Hook] WARNING: console.log found in $file" >&2
        has_console=true
      fi
    done <<< "$modified_files"
    if [ "$has_console" = true ]; then
      echo "[Hook] Remove console.log statements before committing" >&2
    fi
  fi
fi
echo "$input"
